first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A dark gray-black handgun continuously visible in the lower-right foreground, with an angular slide and a partially visible gun body; the lower grip area is occluded by a hand and the edge of the frame.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: An older man with gray-white hair, wearing a long white coat, a blue shirt, a red-and-dark-colored tie, and khaki pants; in the earlier portion, he has his head lowered and knees bent, and in the later portion, he stands upright facing the camera.

entities.name: riveted metal wall panel
entities.identification: Large light-gray to blue-gray rectangular wall panels enclosing the interior, with seams and rows of dark-colored rivets along the edges.

entities.name: metal floor
entities.identification: A gray-brown indoor floor with a slight gray-green tint, square section seams, and repeating light-and-dark textures; in the final frame, only a small portion is exposed near the left side of the bottom edge.

entities.name: dark-colored metal ceiling
entities.identification: A partial gray ceiling panel located along the top edge in the upward-tilted view in the later portion, with darker edges, adjoining the top of the wall.
